prompt: Find the wiki page of ohmyzsh on GitHub and tell me how to change the theme of zsh to agnoster.

success_criteria.notes: Must open ohmyzsh wiki and report how to set theme to agnoster (ZSH_THEME).

prompt: On arXiv, open the Electrical Engineering and Systems Science section search, query keyword 'autonomous vehicles', set the date filter or sort so you can report how many results show for submissions in the most recent complete UTC calendar day that has an index (use arXiv's own date UI). Report the count and the query URL. If the site has no per-day count, report the first-page result count for the keyword under eess and state that limitation.

success_criteria.notes: Prefer WebVoyager reference_answer.json when present; else llm_judge/human. Temporal/live values OK; judge consistency with page at run time, not a frozen gold string.

prompt: Using Google Search starting at google.com, find the official NBA team page or Wikipedia page for the Los Angeles Lakers and report: (1) the page title, (2) the official team website domain if shown, (3) the arena name listed on that page.

success_criteria.notes: Prefer WebVoyager reference_answer.json when present; else llm_judge/human.

prompt: Find the used Nintendo Switch Lite on Amazon then filter by 'Used - Good', tell me the cheapest one that is 'Used - Good'.

success_criteria.notes: Used-inventory and prices change. Success = correctly apply Used-Good filter and report the then-cheapest matching listing title+price; do not grade against a frozen price. Temporal/live values OK; judge consistency with page at run time, not a frozen gold string.

prompt: Browse the Coursera website and find the price required for one year of Coursera Plus. How much is the discount? Then list 3 companies that work with Coursera.

success_criteria.notes: Coursera Plus price/discount and partner list may change. Success = quote the currently displayed annual price, any stated discount, and 3 partner companies from the page. Temporal/live values OK; judge consistency with page at run time, not a frozen gold string.

prompt: On ESPN, open NBA and find the Team Transactions (or Transactions) listing. Report three transactions shown on the page with team name and a short description. Prefer items dated within the last 14 days if the UI shows dates; otherwise report the top three listed and note the date labels.

success_criteria.notes: Prefer WebVoyager reference_answer.json when present; else llm_judge/human. Temporal/live values OK; judge consistency with page at run time, not a frozen gold string.

prompt: Compare the prices and chips for the iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro models directly from Apple's website.

success_criteria.notes: Must report price and chip for iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro from Apple.com (or state if a model is no longer listed and use the closest current Pro comparison the site offers, documenting the substitution).

prompt: Compare the maximum number of private repositories allowed in the Free and Pro plans in GitHub Pricing.

success_criteria.notes: Must open GitHub Pricing and state Free vs Pro private-repository limits.
